bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) benchmark, which measures sensitivity to social biases and stereotypes through exact match accuracy in ambiguous and disambiguous multiple-choice question-answering contexts.
Evaluated using the bias-focused text classification dataset EMGSD, measuring fairness and bias scores to validate steering effectiveness for bias mitigation and amplification.
